02 / Consulting capabilities

Full-lifecycle SAP, built on best practice.

We configure SAP the way it was designed to run. Less custom code means faster go-lives, painless upgrades and a lower cost of ownership.

All consulting services
01

Greenfield implementation

Stand up SAP S/4HANA from scratch on SAP best practice, with minimal customisation so you go live sooner and upgrade more easily.

02

Migration

Move from legacy ERP or older SAP releases to S/4HANA with structured data migration, reconciliation and validation.

03

Application support

Keep production stable after go-live with responsive functional and technical support from consultants who know your system.

04

Custom enhancement

Extend standard SAP only where it adds real value: reports, forms, interfaces and Fiori apps built to last.

05

Testing

Unit, integration and user-acceptance testing that takes the risk out of every release.

06

End-user documentation

Clear process guides and training material that your teams will actually use on day one.

03 / How we deliver

Five phases. Zero guesswork.

Every engagement follows a proven SAP implementation methodology, governed with Solution Manager from preparation to maintenance.

01 Phase one

Prepare

Scope, project charter, team and landscape set-up, with Solution Manager in place from day one.

CharterLandscape
02 Phase two

Design

Fit-to-standard workshops map your processes onto SAP best practice and surface the real gaps.

WorkshopsBlueprint
03 Phase three

Realise

Configuration, essential enhancements, data migration, and unit and integration testing.

BuildTest
04 Phase four

Deploy

User-acceptance testing, end-user training and documentation, cut-over and go-live.

05 Phase five

Maintain

Hypercare and application support that keep the system healthy and improving.

SupportOptimise
